entries.source: chills your foe dealing %d damage and slowing them by one tenth of a turn
entries.target: 冷冻你的敌人，造成%d伤害，并使其损失十分之一个回合。

entries.source: On critical strikes generates a 3 tiles lightning beam.
entries.target: 暴击制造范围3的闪电射线。

entries.source: Mana regeneration, on spell hit 25%% chances to cast lightning.
entries.target: 魔力回复，法术命中有25%%几率触发闪电术。

entries.source: Allows the use of Technomancy spells.
Unleash a lightning nova of radius equal to the tinker tier.
entries.target: 放出半径相当于插件等级的闪电攻击。

entries.source: Deals lightning damage and drains resources.
entries.target: 造成闪电伤害，吸取资源。

entries.source: shock your foe dealing %d damage and draining some of their resources
entries.target: 电击你的敌人，造成 %d 点伤害，并吸取其部分资源。

entries.source: "Great for combat, cooking, and shaving! We accept no responsibility for ruined follicles."
entries.target: "适合战斗、烹饪和刮胡子！毛囊受损概不负责。"

entries.source: deal lightning damage to the target based on cunning with a 25% chance to daze, and arc to up to 3 targets.
entries.target: 对目标造成基于灵巧的闪电伤害，并有25%几率震慑，跳跃到最多3个目标。

entries.source: Strikes can trigger a thunderclap that damages and repel foes.
entries.target: 攻击有几率触发霹雳震爆，伤害并击退敌人。

entries.source: Deals fire damage and ignites the ground.
entries.target: 造成火焰伤害，点燃大地。

entries.source: burn your foe dealing %d damage and igniting the ground for 4 turns
entries.target: 灼烧敌人，造成%d伤害，并点燃地面4回合。

entries.source: "I never really liked that village anyway." - Charlta, Mad Inventor
entries.target: “反正我本来就不喜欢那个村庄。”——疯狂发明家查尔塔
